Delhi Fire Incident Sparks Political Debate Over Protester Actions

Reports indicate that the Centre has instructed states to prevent protesters from traveling to Delhi, a move that has drawn opposition from various political parties. The situation is described as a "Delhi fire" gathering steam from states, with parties opposing a crackdown on young protesters.
